integrity: The complete 102-tetrahedron complex is embedded. An exact integral kernel basis and left inverse are certified, the H2 quotient determinant is recomputed as 2, every support through seven vertices is exhausted through a necessary mod-two detector, and all five surviving supports are independently verified as induced orientable tori with integral fundamental cycles representing the nonzero class.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns vertex support in the fixed labelled seventeen-vertex B3 triangulation. It does not classify larger carriers, compare alternate triangulations, or optimize Euclidean area. The associated ZIB report is month-resolved only, so the date field uses the earliest inspected day-resolved public release.
title: Five induced seven-vertex tori are the shortest integral \(H_2\)-torsion carriers in \(\mathcal B_3\)
